issues.claim: Twin Boro Physical Therapy - Parlin, 3276 Washington Rd
issues.problem: Chain-scale provider left in the list. Twin Boro's own locations page lists roughly 51 New Jersey offices, several under acquired sub-brands (Bayonne, Bridgewater, Butler, Belvedere/WorkCare, Berlin/Breakthru, Cape May and more). The mapper excluded Kessler Rehabilitation Center (2909 Washington Rd) as a chain but kept a direct competitor of the same scale, so the chain rule was applied inconsistently. If the team's definition of chain is narrowly 'national', this entry can stand - the list itself flags it for that decision.
issues.fix: Drop it, or record an explicit team decision that NJ-only regional chains count as independent and apply the same rule to Garden State Therapy Group.

issues.claim: Garden State Physical Therapy Group, 333 Cheesequake Rd
issues.problem: Its own site (gardenstateptchiro.com) advertises 10+ offices across New Jersey (Freehold, Colonia, Millburn, Carteret, Sayreville, ...), so it is a multi-site group rather than a single-location practice. It also operates inside The Aquatics & Fitness Center rather than as a stand-alone business.
issues.fix: Treat the same way as Twin Boro: exclude as a multi-site group, or state the chain threshold and apply it consistently.

issues.claim: Website field left blank for businesses that do have their own site
issues.problem: At least eight listed businesses publish their own sites while the list shows website as empty: Sayreville Dental (sayrevilledental.com), Apex Dental (apexdentalnj.com), Smile Spa of Parlin / Dr. Silman (drsilmansmilespa.com), Old Bridge Vision Center (oldbridgevision.net), Potash Chiropractic (potashchiropractic.com), Winter Wellness Acupuncture (winterwellnessacu.com), Parlin Nails Spa (parlinnailsspa.com), Jeffrey A. Gee DDS (jeffreygeedentist.com). Not an accuracy error, but it weakens outreach prep and hides which firms are online.
issues.fix: Backfill website from each practice's own site (URLs above came back from search or were opened).

issues.claim: Core Physical Therapy, 777 Washington Rd, town listed as Sayreville
issues.problem: Inconsistent with the rest of the list: 777 Washington Rd is the Parlin 08859 address used for Huma Beauty Salon, Tribal Barbers and Shadow Nails (all town=Parlin). Its only source is a YellowPages category page, so address and town are unconfirmed.
issues.fix: Set town to Parlin and re-verify the practice still operates there, or drop it as a one-directory entry.

issues.problem: The list says the address is not published, but a salon directory entry for the same business shows 389 Washington Road, Sayreville - the address already used for Miracle Beauty Salon. Either the address is published or the two entries are the same salon.
issues.fix: Resolve the two entries at 389 Washington Rd: confirm whether Hair by Cris is separate and fill in the address, or merge/drop.

issues.problem: Sourced only from an NPI-registry page, which is a provider mailing address and may be a residence; the list itself doubts it is an operating business. Nothing I opened shows a public commercial presence in Sayreville.
issues.fix: Confirm a public business presence (own site or a listing with hours) before any outreach; otherwise drop it.
